title: Argentine deputy Marcela Pagano claims in a criminal complaint that the Chamber of Deputies' systems were hacked and the attack concealed
date_note: Perfil's article of 25 Nov reports the complaint; the page gives no earlier day for the filing, so the publication day is used.
org: Cámara de Diputados de la Nación (Argentina)
geo_basis: Argentine Chamber of Deputies, seat in Buenos Aires; the source does not state a city for the systems
summary: According to Perfil, deputy Marcela Pagano filed a criminal complaint against Chamber president Martín Menem, alleging he concealed a cyberattack on Congress's digital systems. Perfil reports that parts of the Chamber's website have been restricted or inaccessible. It says no explanation from Menem or the Chamber had been published and no technical account of whether a hack occurred.
plain: A deputy alleges in a court complaint that the Chamber of Deputies was hacked and the matter hidden. Perfil reports no official explanation; whether a hack happened is not established.
exec: An allegation, not an established breach: Perfil reports no official account of what happened to the Chamber's systems.

sources.name: Perfil: Marcela Pagano denuncia que hackearon el sitio de Diputados y el Gobierno lo oculta

validation.note: Only Perfil (also syndicated as perfil.com, one publisher) was read; it relays the deputy's complaint and an El Disenso investigation. No statement from the Chamber was found.
